Release Runbook: WMS 7.4 at Kestrel Point Distribution Centre
Operations Engineering · Version 3 · 22 October 2026

Change IDCHG-26-0918Maintenance windowSaturday 31 October 2026, 22:00 - 02:00 (local time)Change ownerR. Haverkamp, Platform TeamRollback decision point00:30 at the latestAffected serviceswms-api, wms-picking, label-printer-gateway
1. Purpose

This runbook describes how to deploy release 7.4 of the warehouse management system to the production cluster at Kestrel Point. The release introduces wave picking for chilled goods and replaces the label printer gateway.
2. Pre-checks
Confirm the change is approved in the change calendar
Check the state of the cluster
All nodes report Ready
No pods in CrashLoopBackOff
Disk usage on database volumes below 70 %
Notify the shift supervisor
Picking stops at 21:45
Trucks scheduled after 22:00 are loaded manually
Take a database snapshot and record its identifier
3. Deployment
3.1 Update the release values
Set the image tags and the feature flag in the environment file before running the pipeline.

release: "7.4.0" images: wms-api: registry.internal/wms/api:7.4.0 wms-picking: registry.internal/wms/picking:7.4.0 label-gateway: registry.internal/wms/label-gateway:2.0.3 features: chilled _ wave _picking: true legacy_ label _ spooler: false replicas: wms-api: 4 wms-picking: 3
3.2 Run the deployment
Put the site into maintenance mode from the operations console.
Run the database migration job and wait for it to complete.
Deploy the services with the commands below.
Take the site out of maintenance mode.

kubectl config use-context kpdc-prod kubectl -n wms apply -f release-7.4.0.yaml kubectl -n wms rollout status deploy/wms-api --timeout=10m
kubectl -n wms rollout status deploy/wms-picking --timeout=10m
If a rollout does not finish within ten minutes, stop and go to section 5.
4. Verification

CheckWhereExpected resultOwnerAPI healthGET /health on wms-apiHTTP 200 and version 7.4.0PlatformWave creationPicking console, test site KP-TESTChilled wave created within 30 secondsOperationsLabel printingPrinter bank B, dock 4Test label printed with new layoutOperationsOrder backlogDatabase query belowNo orders stuck in status ALLOCATINGPlatform
at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM outbound _ order WHERE updated _ GROUP BY status;
5. Rollback
Rollback restores release 7.3.2 and the database snapshot taken during the pre-checks. Orders created after the snapshot must be re-imported from the transport management system.
